pipeline_stages.details: Acquired real raster for asset 'thumbnail' (16372 bytes).
Normalized DN to Sigma-0 (SIGMA_NAUGHT_DB) with dynamic range [-21.7 dB, 0.0 dB].
Applied REFINED_LEE filter with 5x5 kernel to suppress multiplicative noise.
Mapped 160x120 pixel grid to WGS 84 BBox [-6.00, 35.50, -5.00, 36.50] with ~10.0m resolution.
Computed background sea statistics: Mean = -7.63 dB, Std = 3.38 dB. Anomaly cutoff = -14.39 dB.
Identified 2 unverified low-backscatter anomaly candidate clusters requiring multimodal corroboration.

scientific_disclaimer: Scientific Integrity Notice: Anomaly candidates detected through SAR backscatter damping represent surface capillary wave attenuation. They must be treated strictly as unverified candidates. Separation of real hydrocarbon films from natural look-alikes (low-wind zones, biogenic slicks, internal waves) requires multimodal corroboration via AIS vessel tracking, optical radiometry, or in-situ AUV telemetry.
